\begin{example} \end{example}[monodromy map of a universal cover]

Source: petersen:page-0217 ↗ thm:pet-ch5-monodromy-theorem 1. ch5:5.6.11If $M$ is the universal cover of $S^2-\{ \pm p\} $, the monodromy map is not one-to-one; it is exactly the covering map $M\to S^2-\{ \pm p\} $. \end{example}
